The '''Watchman blaster''' was a survival pistol that could match the performance of a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster]] when fully upgraded. Their stun capabilities rendered them useful as off-hand weapons for those beings who preferred combat with two ranged weapons.
